About Jupiter

Jupiter is the leading swap aggregator on Solana, also offering perpetuals and limit orders. JUP is used for governance of the Jupiter DAO.

Where this JUP price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (JUP/USDT) and Kraken (JUP/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 3.32B JUP (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
